_doc: Save record schemas (re/a6/SAVES_PLAN.md 3.2). One section per batch; re/save/gen_save.py turns every record without "todo" into src/save/gen/records_<section>.hpp (field table + put_<name> / get_<name>) and re/save/gen/schema_<section>.json (savecmp.py). Keys: class = joan::orig C++ class (its real layout, read with libclang); from/size = the chunk = bytes [from, from+size) of the object; legacy = raw | image_words (what the old raw path did, for SaveCompare); image_words = every 4-byte scalar at a chunk dword offset carried under Ptr::Image; ptr = {member path: Flag|Cleared|Kept|Image|Stale} (every pointer member in the range needs one); opaque = [[from, size]] byte-array ranges kept verbatim on purpose (SaveAudit=2 labels them); todo = not converted yet (inventory of SAVES_PLAN 2.2, notes = the reader's pointer handling).

sav._doc: .SAV layout for savecmp.py: "RSav" chunk, header chunks (GameFile::write_header 0x478cc0), marker chunk 0x2facebee, then 20 steps each followed by the marker. A step grammar is a list of items: "chunk:<record>" | "chunk:<n>" | "long" | "short"; steps without one are compared as bytes.

s4.name: Game
writer: 0x00484780 gfile3.cpp Obj::save_484780 (.SAV step 4: this, then Scenario +0x17, the EndCons, the two word arrays)
reader: 0x004848a0 gfile3.cpp Obj::save_4848a0 (the load counterpart despite the name)
s4.notes: The chunk holds the embedded Scenario (+0x17) and the 40 EndCons (+0x30b) once more: the reader reads them here, then the Scenario chunk (0x00483f10) and the EndCon chunks (0x004842c0, i < end_condition_count) overwrite them, so every scenario.* pointer of this chunk is Cleared (overwritten) and end_conditions[i].text/text2 are Stale: overwritten for i < count, zero in unused slots (add_slot memset 0x1a, EndCon::release) and only freed when non-null. word_set / word_stack: freed before the read, re-allocated after it (Cleared). gap_2a0 (0x14): only +0x2b0..+0x2b3 is accessed, as the [0] element of the script value table +0x2b0 + mode*0x14 + i*4 (0x00659fd2 / 0x0065a09f, script int arguments): pointer-free (see Scenario for +0x248).

s4.name: Scenario
s4.notes: entries: re-allocated when entry_count > 0, else never used (Scenario::reset 0x004cc850 frees it only inside the entry loop) - Stale. local.*: overwritten by the local entry's own chunk (0x00483ca0), which clears script (0x00483dd0). types / items / squads: zeroed by clear_277 0x00484160 (with type_count / item_count), squads re-allocated when squad_count != 0. Gaps: gap_1d6 (4) and gap_273 (2) have no access in the binary (asm_facts this / Game+0x17 paths, absolute 0xa58fa7+off) nor in the C++; gap_231 (2) + id_list_pad (+0x233) are one i32 script counter (Game +0x248 = 0xa591d8: 0x00659a60 add, 0x00659a90 set, 0x00659ac0 get, 0x006f9af5 printed as a number): integers, pointer-free.
